title: pending_item_ops
summary: MSUI pending item operations record both move ends as one operation with each slot's guid/count baseline. Slots gray immediately, resolve together when either guid/count changes, reset across sessions, and clear promptly on nonzero SMSG_INVENTORY_CHANGE_FAILURE by matching the named item or conservatively clearing all when unattributed.

openItems.text: SMSG_INVENTORY_CHANGE_FAILURE is not handled anywhere (opcode absent from the switch): a server-refused move never unlocks the slots promptly (and surfaces no error) - MSUI substitutes a 5-second timeout, so a refused operation leaves slots dark for up to 5s where the reference unlocks on the failure packet
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: inventory-failure dispatch now clears the matched operation as a unit, or all pending locks for zero/unmatched item guid, instead of waiting for the timeout.
